name: Hẹn hò dưới sao
notes: A date on a starry night (the shared grown-up couple in templates/_models: Grab3D's Casual Man and Casual Woman with Quaternius's animations, CC0; she is fitted at .945 of his height; the moon, the street lamp and the picnic blanket are built in story.js). Stop 1: they walk in from both sides, he waves, she claps, a note with the card's first words (slot note1) pops up. Stop 2: a picnic blanket unrolls, they sit down together under a shooting star and the card's photo rises in a glow with its caption (slot caption). Stop 3: they stand, hug and kiss, hearts burst and a banner with the last words (slot note2) rises among fireworks. The next tap opens the letter. The act is the shared templates/_acts/lovestory.js; this card's own moves are in story.js.
